subject: Security & identity follow-up — MediSuite demo recap and evidence requests
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@medisuite.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Security & identity follow-up — MediSuite demo recap and evidence requests

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the demo today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can complete security qualification and get a technical kickoff scheduled for SSO/SCIM work.

Recap from today's discovery
- Scope: pilot integration for triage workflows + embeddings. Data residency: US-only.
- Compliance signals you mentioned: SOC 2 in progress (expected Type II later this year), GDPR handling in EU regions, HIPAA applicability for PHI routes.

Primary asks (please see attachments for a filled vendor questionnaire and an evidence matrix template):
1) Vendor security questionnaire: please complete the attached workbook (ms-health-security-questionnaire.xlsx).
2) SOC 2 / audit status: a redacted SOC 2 report or timeline for the Type II completion. If you have an interim attestation or SOC 2 readiness report, that helps accelerate our review.
3) Identity & Access evidence (high-priority for our security review):
   - SSO/SAML: SAML metadata file (XML) or IdP metadata URL; assertion attributes you plan to provide (email, name, groups).
   - SCIM: SCIM API endpoint, auth type (token/OAuth2), and provisioning scope (create/update/deactivate).
   - RBAC: short role mapping matrix (which groups map to admin/superuser/standard user).
   - Admin controls & audit logs: retention window for admin activity logs, sample event names (e.g., user_created, role_assigned, token_revoked).
4) Any regulatory docs relevant to HIPAA/GDPR (BAA in progress? data processing addendum).

Timing & next steps
- Can you return the questionnaire + SSO metadata by EOD Thu 2028-03-16?
- If available, please include a point of contact for Okta/IDP admin (we'll need an Okta admin or service account for a short test).
- Proposed technical kickoff for SSO/SCIM: 30 minutes — tentative windows next week.

We attached an "iam-evidence-matrix-template.csv" to show the exact fields our security team will need. I'll loop in Neha (security) and Ben (compliance) on any follow-ups.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
Redwood Inference

Jonas / Ben — saw Olivia's note and attachments. A few internal items and minimal acceptance criteria from security: 

1) SSO/SAML (minimum to approve test):
   - IdP SAML metadata (XML) or metadata URL.
   - Confirm NameID format and attributes (email is required).
   - IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated behavior documented.

2) SCIM provisioning:
   - SCIM base URL + token auth header examples.
   - CRUD scope for accounts and group sync.
   - Rate limits and approximate provisioning volume.

3) RBAC / admin controls:
   - Short CSV showing group -> role mapping (we can sanitize).
   - Evidence of admin separation (who can create service accounts, who can grant enterprise admin).

4) Audit logs / retention:
   - Sample log events (admin_create_user, admin_delete_user, token_revoked) and retention window.

Acceptable evidence types: metadata files, API examples, screenshots of policy pages (redact PII), redacted SOC2 readiness report.

If Olivia can't share certain internal artifacts, we can accept scoped screenshots + API examples for the purpose of initial qualification. Please push the questionnaire back to Olivia asking specifically for a SAML metadata export and a SCIM test token (short-lived) by 2028-03-16.

I'll prepare a one-page checklist for the kickoff so the tech session can be purely hands-on (SAML upload + SCIM provisioning test).

Neha Kapoor
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
